    StartersWilderness Explorer honey trail mix barsToasted oat bars bound with honey, peanut butter and butterHow to make it250g rolled oats150g honey120g peanut butter60g butter80g roasted peanuts80g sultanas50g banana chips, crushed80g chocolate chipsHeat the oven to 170°C and line a 20 x 30cm tin. Toast the oats for 10 minutes.Warm the honey, peanut butter and butter until smooth. Stir in the oats, peanuts, sultanas and banana chips.Cool the mixture for 10 minutes, then fold in the chocolate chips.Press firmly into the tin and bake for 15 minutes.Cool completely before cutting into squares.MainsMuntz's roast sirloin dinnerRoast sirloin with roast potatoes, rich gravy and green beansHow to make it1.5kg beef sirloin1kg potatoes, cut into chunks2 tbsp olive oil500ml beef stock50g butter300g green beansRoast the potatoes with the oil at 200°C until golden.Roast the sirloin at 200°C to 52°C inside, then rest.Reduce the beef stock to a sauce and whisk in some butter.Steam the beans and toss in butter.Paradise Falls shredded chicken arepasThe South American cliffs Ellie always wanted to seeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp golden corn arepas split open and stuffed with shredded chicken and avocado salad, with grated cheese and a fresh green coriander sauce.Poach 600g chicken breast for 15 minutes and shred.Mix with 1 mashed avocado, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, lime juice, coriander and salt.Mix 300g pre-cooked white corn flour with 450ml warm water and 1 tsp salt, rest 5 minutes and shape 8 discs 1.5cm thick.Cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 6 minutes a side until crisp.Blend coriander, 1 green chilli, garlic, lime and 80ml oil for the sauce.Split the arepas and fill.SweetsKevin's chocolateDark chocolate bark with hazelnuts, dried cherries and flaky saltHow to make it300g dark chocolate60g hazelnuts, toasted60g dried cherries1 pinch flaky sea saltMelt the chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray.Scatter with hazelnuts, cherries and flaky salt.Set in the fridge, then break into shards. Save some for the bird.Grape soda badge jelliesGrape juice jellies set in small round mouldsHow to make it6 gelatine leaves500ml grape juice2 tbsp caster sugar1 lemon, juiced100ml thickened cream, whippedSoak the gelatine leaves in cold water.Warm the grape juice with the sugar and a squeeze of lemon and stir in the squeezed gelatine.Pour into small round moulds and set in the fridge for 3 hours.Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.DrinksEllie's grape soda floatsGrape juice and soda with lime, vanilla ice cream and frozen grapesHow to make it100g red grapes600ml purple grape juice400ml chilled soda water1 lime, juiced8 scoops of vanilla ice creamFreeze the grapes for 2 hours.Mix the grape juice with the soda water and a squeeze of lime.Put ice cream in each tall glass and pour the grape soda over slowly so it foams up.Drop in a few frozen grapes and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
